title: Bootstrapped SDK Sprintwave: starter kits, microdocs, and onboarding labs initiative
creator: Asha Patel
description: Goal: Deliver a reusable set of 'Starter Kits' (SDK templates, minimal sample apps, and 5 microdocs/quickstarts per language) to reduce time-to-first-successful-request for new developers from ~45 minutes to <=10 minutes. This initiative bundles code samples, CI checks, and telemetry hooks so SDKs can be bootstrapped and maintained consistently across languages.
success_metrics: activation_lift: new users who complete starter kit are 3x more likely to call generation endpoint in 7 days
reduced support tickets for onboarding by 40% in target cohort
milestones: M1: baseline telemetry & instrumentation added to SDKs (2026-02-24)
M2: Node starter kit + quickstarts published + sample app template (2026-03-10)
M3: Python starter kit + CI + docs micro-site (2026-03-24)
M4: Go starter kit + integration tests + telemetry dashboard (2026-04-02)
M5: Cross-language playbook, eng runbook, and kickoff webinar (2026-04-07)
acceptance_criteria: Starter kit repo for each language with README, one-click example, and github actions CI
Docs quickstart page with step-by-step, expected responses, and troubleshooting section
Telemetry events instrumented: starter_kit_started, sample_app_run_success, quickstart_completed
Automated e2e smoke test that runs in CI and flips a 'starter-kit-ready' flag
Internal playbook for Developer Success to run cohort onboarding and measure lift
progress_updates: 2026-02-12: Kickoff meeting with Eng (Samira Chen), DX (Ravi Singh), and Docs (Marta Ruiz). Agreed on Node/Python/Go triage and telemetry contract.
2026-02-20: Engineering spike completed for minimal CI pattern; opted for GitHub Actions matrix to simplify language support. Trade-off: slightly longer PR runtime but easier maintenance.

2026-03-01: Node starter kit PR opened (github.com/redwood-inference/starter-node#42). Code review feedback from infra: pinning GH action runners for reproducible builds. Assigned ENG-49270 follow-up for runner pinning.
2026-03-04: Docs draft live in staging (confluence://devx/starter-kits-draft). UX review requested — comment thread recommends adding 'expected API response' snippet for each quickstart.
2026-03-08: Telemetry schema v1 finalized. Collector events listed in linked spreadsheet. Open dependency: analytics infra needs a metric tile to measure starter_kit_install_success (DEP-ENG-7768).

2026-03-10: Node starter kit published at npm and linked from docs; observed 88% install_success in synthetic cohort — short of 95% target. Root cause: outdated node-gyp on some environments; added troubleshooting note and fallback instructions.
2026-03-12: Python starter kit skeleton merged, CI flaky tests flagged. Plan: dedicate 1 sprint to stabilize tests (estimate 3 points). Updated risk register.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: CI flakiness slows release cadence — Mitigation: prioritize deterministic container images and add retry logic to e2e smoke tests.
Risk: Telemetry gaps cause blind spots — Mitigation: add SDK-level unit tests validating emitted events and add a pre-release telemetry smoke job.
Risk: Maintenance burden for multiple language repos — Mitigation: centralize common scripts and templating via starter-kit scaffold generator.
Risk: Docs friction (too many steps) — Mitigation: enforce max 5 steps in quickstarts and include copy-paste snippets for CLI and curl flows.
reviews_and_feedback: Design (Marta Ruiz): requested clearer success state visuals in quickstarts — added 'What success looks like' box to each page.
Security (Jordan Lee): noted no high-risk crypto usage; recommended adding guidance for KMS integration for Private customers — added as optional section.
Docs (Hannah Park): suggested shorter, snackable microdocs; we split long guides into 5 microdocs per language.
next_steps: Stabilize Python CI and run telemetry smoke job (assigned to ENG-Squad A)
Create 'starter-kit-ready' dashboard and pin to DevX Console home for the PM and Eng leads
Schedule a cross-functional demo and webinar for April 9th to onboard Developer Success and Sales engineers
Collect first 1k new user cohort metrics post-Node rollout and evaluate against success_metrics
